messages:
marie: Quick sync — Kumo marketplace listing goes live Tue 10am PT. We need:
1) joint technical webinar script
2) co-blog copy + CTAs
3) inbound lead routing + UTMs.

aj: I'll own the webinar script. Can we aim for 30m + 15m Q&A? :thumbsup:

samir: I'll take the co-blog draft. Need partner quotes from Kumo — @marie do you have the contact?

marie: @samir yes, Kumo PR (eric) confirmed short quote. I'll DM.

lucy: For inbound routing — do we want leads straight to sales queue or to a partner-qualified SDR? I vote partner-qualified SDR to avoid double-touch.

marta: +1 partner-qualified. Also suggest a webhook to our CRM with tags: source=kumo_marketplace, campaign=kumo_launch_2024, utm_medium=webinar

ops-bot: webhook template created: /integrations/crm-webhook -> payload sample attached

aj: Webinar outline draft:
```
- 0-5m: Welcome + product positioning
- 5-15m: Joint walkthrough (Redwood + Kumo)
- 15-25m: Deep dive: performance/benchmark highlights
- 25-30m: Deployment patterns & migration tips
- 30-45m: Live Q&A
```

lucy: Can you add a slide with "expected latency & cost savings" and a short benchmark table? Also need one-sentence elevator for registration page.

samir: Blog skeleton:
- intro to partnership
- why marketplaces matter
- integration walkthrough
- benchmark callouts
- CTA: try hosted or request dedicated

marie: I'll prep the registration form copy. For tracking: share final UTM values by EOD Fri.

aj: Need a rehearsal — can everyone do Tue 9am PT? @kumo-eric confirm?

kumo-eric: (in thread) we can do 9am, will send slides.

lucy: Heads up: routing rule:
- leads with company size > 500 -> AE queue
- others -> partner-qualified SDR
We'll add a landing page hidden field for partner_id=kumo

marta: I'll config the CRM mapping and set the tag rules.

marie: Okay micromilestones:
- Today: assign owners (done)
- Thu EOD: first drafts (script/slides/blog)
- Fri EOD: final UTMs + routing configured
- Tue 9am: rehearsal
- Tue 10am: go-live

aj: I'll upload slides to /shared/marketing/kumo-launch by Thu.

marie: Thanks everyone — I'll shoot a summary email to Kumo and Sales after rehearsal. :rocket:

deploy-bot: event created: webinar-rehearsal-1717756321 (calendar invite sent)
